scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes the all-index theorem. Finite calculations only replay exact identities and sample trajectories. Established SSP theory and classical recurrence solutions are credited; published equivalent formulations remain possible.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a unique nondegenerate unshifted two-stage branch, not all Chebyshev two-step coefficients.
Sharp sign classification assumes scalar constant-coefficient decay, constant step, strictly positive starts, and exact arithmetic.
No vector, nonlinear, variable-step, or floating-point positivity guarantee.
Numerical threshold digits are generated from the proved root equation, not a proof of global uniqueness by enumeration.
title: Sharp positivity cone and hidden stage sign loss in a two-stage Chebyshev two-step integrator
